title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Electric Charges — 2024
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: State Coulomb's law. Calculate the force between two charges of 2 μC and 3 μC placed 0.1 m apart in air.
questions.knowledgeNote: Coulomb's law: inverse square law. Force is along the line joining the charges.
questions.answer: **Coulomb's law:** the force between two point charges is **directly proportional to the product of the charges and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them**, acting along the line joining them: **F = (1/4πε₀) q₁q₂/r² = k q₁q₂/r²**, with k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻² in air/vacuum. Like charges repel, unlike attract. **Calculation:** q₁ = 2 μC = 2 × 10⁻⁶ C; q₂ = 3 μC = 3 × 10⁻⁶ C; r = 0.1 m. F = (9 × 10⁹ × 2 × 10⁻⁶ × 3 × 10⁻⁶)/(0.1)² = (9 × 10⁹ × 6 × 10⁻¹²)/10⁻² = (5.4 × 10⁻²)/10⁻² = **5.4 N, repulsive** (both charges positive). **Deep point:** the micro-to-coulomb conversion (× 10⁻⁶ twice) and the squared distance are the two classic slip points — the exponent bookkeeping decides the answer.
